observerV2.alignmentPolicy: raw and gauge-aligned L2 distances; gauge-aligned uses shared gauge-invariant-metrics thetaStar convention
observerV2.thetaStarSignConvention: thetaStar is the angle applied to b in exp(+i thetaStar) so b best aligns to a; inherited from gauge-invariant-metrics computeGaugeInvariantABMetrics
observerV2.normalizationPolicy: L2 distances are normalized by finite complex sample count; mode powers remain v2.1.2 observer-normalized where reported
observerV2.closedLoopFloatResidualPolicy: floating-point sanity check only, not a reliability signal
limitations: no biological life / consciousness / agency / permanent survival claim
Closed-loop float residual is not a winding reliability signal. Reliability is estimated from low-amplitude lines and near-π phase steps.

topologicalLedger.strictIntegerGateAppliesBecause: xy plaquette ledger is computed on periodic x/y slices
topologicalLedger.strictGatePolicy: strict integer gates apply only to all-valid synthetic periodic cases; runtime/noisy cases require reliability context
topologicalLedger.invalidPlaquettePolicy: plaquette is invalid if any of its four corner amplitudes are below validityAmpThreshold; invalid counts are reported separately and must not support strict topology claims
topologicalLedger.edgeSharingPolicy: shared periodic x/y edge phase differences are computed once per z-slice and reused with opposite signs for adjacent plaquettes
topologicalLedger.closedPlaquetteFloatResidualPolicy: floating-point sanity check only, not the main phenomenon metric
